audit.verification: AFI explicitly locates Friday, Connie and Streebek’s encounter at Griffith Park Observatory. The existing building pin and real-site photograph are reused; no second Observatory point is introduced. Krupp independently documents Dragnet at the Observatory.
audit.chronology: 1987 is an editorial estimate for the contemporary story, supported by the opening and closing day/date combinations. No exact event day is asserted.
audit.media_review: Both film thumbnails were visually inspected. The Friday frame shows him beside the dome equipment without revealing an outcome. The second frame shows Whirley in the curved telescope dome and is spoiler-protected. The real-site photograph remains undated.
audit.scope: Only the requested Observatory appearance is added. No Spies Like Us appearance, invented death count, backlot or separate romantic-overlook point is inferred.
